title: Strata Graph Definition
description: Compiled graph topology (STRATA-SPEC-004), consumed by `strata graph validate` and equivalent in-process validators in both languages. A parallel group, subgraph or map node describes its inside, and a wait node what it waits for (design/22-Graph-Structure-In-Definitions.md, design/27-Map-Fan-Out.md, design/29-Event-Waits-And-Timers.md); a subgraph's or map's `graph` is a whole definition of this same shape, recursively. A compiled graph with an identity says so in `identity` (design/31-Graph-Identity.md), and an interrupt boundary in its node's `interrupt` (design/48-Boundaries-In-Definitions.md).

schema_version.description: 1.6.0 when a node at this level is an interrupt boundary, one with an `interrupt` (design/48-Boundaries-In-Definitions.md), else 1.5.0 when this level has an `identity` (design/31-Graph-Identity.md), else 1.4.0 when a node at this level is a wait node (design/29-Event-Waits-And-Timers.md), else 1.3.0 when a node at this level is a map (design/27-Map-Fan-Out.md), else 1.2.0 when a parallel group at this level has a `join` (design/26-Parallel-Group-Controls-And-Joins.md), else 1.1.0 when a node at this level has a `kind` (a parallel group or subgraph), else 1.0.0. Each is a superset of the one before. A nested `graph` carries its own. A reader refuses a version it doesn't know.

identity.description: The identity the graph was compiled with (design/31-Graph-Identity.md: CompilationOptions.GraphId / GraphVersion, CompileOptions::with_graph_id / with_graph_version), which every checkpoint level it writes carries as `graph`. Absent, not null, for a graph without one, and in a builder's export (identity is given at compile time). A subgraph's or map's child carries its own. Both keys are always written.

version.description: Free text, compared exactly; null for an unversioned graph.

metadata.description: Description only (agent, model policy, ...), set with SetNodeMetadata / set_node_metadata; the engines never read it. Keys are non-empty, never start with the reserved prefix 'strata.', and are written sorted.

kind.description: Absent for a plain node. A parallel_group has `branches`; a subgraph has `graph`; a map has `graph`, the template each item runs (design/27-Map-Fan-Out.md); a wait node has `wait` (design/29-Event-Waits-And-Timers.md).

wait.description: A wait node's wait (design/29-Event-Waits-And-Timers.md): the run freezes after the node until it is answered. Every key is always written. Validation refuses a wait node inside a map's template, at any depth (STRATA_ERR_WAIT_IN_MAP).

kind.description: An external event (a signal of `event_type` answers it), or a timer (due `delay_ms` after the node ran, or at a time computed from the state).

event_type.description: An event wait's event type; null for a timer.

delay_ms.description: A timer's fixed delay in milliseconds; null when it is computed from the state, and for an event wait.

timeout_ms.description: An event wait's timeout in milliseconds, after which it continues at its guarded `on_timeout` edge, or the thread is ended; null when it never times out, and for a timer.

interrupt.description: Present exactly when the node is an interrupt boundary (design/48-Boundaries-In-Definitions.md): the run freezes after the node until a human answers it. Any node but a wait node may be one. Its reject and timeout routes are its guarded `on_reject` and `on_timeout` edges, not repeated here; at a 1.6.0 level an `on_reject` edge comes only from a node with `interrupt`, and an `on_timeout` edge only from one with a timeout (the readers check this). Validation refuses one inside a map's template, at any depth (STRATA_ERR_BOUNDARY_IN_MAP). The key is always written.

timeout_ms.description: The boundary's timeout in whole milliseconds, after which it continues at its guarded `on_timeout` edge, or, with none, the thread is ended `timed_out` (design/29-Event-Waits-And-Timers.md); null when it never times out.

branches.description: A parallel group's branches, in declaration order. Branches have no edges: they all start when the group starts.

graph.description: A subgraph's child, or a map's template (the child graph every item runs): its whole definition, with its own schema_version. Validation names a template's nodes with a `*` segment for the item (`Investigate/*/Assess`).

join.description: A parallel group's or a map's join, written only when it isn't the default (`all`, `fail_group`); design/26-Parallel-Group-Controls-And-Joins.md, design/27-Map-Fan-Out.md. Concurrency limits, timeouts and a map's item limit are not exported.

policy.description: When the group is done: every branch succeeded, one did, one whose result passes a predicate did, or `count` did.

count.description: A quorum's count, null for every other policy. Validation refuses one below 1, or, on a parallel group, above the branch count (STRATA_ERR_INVALID_QUORUM); a map's items are counted at run time.

condition.description: A first_matching predicate's description, or null. The predicate itself isn't exported.

partial.description: What a join that can no longer be met does: fail the group, or reduce over every branch's outcome (failing only if none succeeded).

guarded.description: True if a conditional router protects this edge from being an unguarded cycle (STRATA_ERR_UNGUARDED_CYCLE).

condition.description: Optional human-readable description of the guard condition. The engines write it only on their synthetic edges: 'on_failure' for a recovery-policy fallback (design/04-Error-Recovery.md), 'on_reject' for an interrupt boundary's reject route (design/21-Typed-Human-Signals.md), and 'on_timeout' for a timed boundary's or an event wait's timeout route (design/29-Event-Waits-And-Timers.md), all guarded.
